name: zimage_texdir_entry_get_variant_image_at_index
description: zImage_TexDirEntry::GetVariantImageAtIndex walks a texture-directory variant chain by index and returns the selected variant image, clamping negative indices to the base entry and overlarge indices to the last linked variant.
known_limits: VC5SP3 COFF byte comparison for 0x46e290 passes with zero unmasked function-byte mismatches after 4 relocation-masked bytes and 13 trimmed VC NOP bytes.
VC5SP3 data-symbol target zimage_default_image_data passes for g_zImage_DefaultImagePixels and g_zImage_DefaultImage, covering the null-this default-image return.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x46e290 validates the null-this default image return, non-positive index base-image return, nextVariant walk through offset 0x20, stop at the requested index or last linked variant, and return of the selected entry image pointer.
The native smoke verifies negative, zero, first-variant, second-variant, and overlarge index cases across a three-entry variant chain.
